thread:
maria: Quick ask — design team, need 3 visual variants for the launch. Outputs: benchmark hero (web banner), 2 social tiles (1:1), webinar slide (16:9). Target: initial thumbs by EOD today, final exports by Tue 3pm PT. Can the team take this?
alejandra: Got it, pinged. Can you confirm hero pixel size and whether we should include a full data viz or a simplified sparkline?
maria: Hero 1200x600. Use simplified sparkline + one callout stat. Callout copy draft: "3x throughput, 35% lower cost" — @sam to confirm microcopy.
sam: Confirmed. Slight tweak: "3x throughput. 35% lower token cost." Keep it punchy.
alejandra: Cool. Any brand constraints? gradients allowed? heavy shadows?
jon: Avoid saturated gradients on the hero. Use brand gradient palette only (primary -> tertiary). No heavy drop shadows. Include logo lockup bottom-left and small legal line: "Results may vary" in 10pt.
legal-ops-bot: Heads up — cost claim needs attribution. Suggest: "Based on Redwood internal benchmark; results vary by workload and config." I'll post the exact legal snippet in the thread.
maria: Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/launch-kit — exporting frames; please name exports: LNCH_hero_v1.png, LNCH_tileA_v1.png, LNCH_tileB_v1.png, LNCH_webinar_v1.pdf. Deliver PNGs at 1x and 2x.
alejandra: Plan: v1 full viz, v2 simplified sparkline, v3 high-contrast variant for social. Will drop options in Figma and add comments for copy placements. Need exact stat number format (comma vs decimal)?
sam: Use commas for thousands, no unit for percent (e.g., "35%"). Callout should be sentence-case.
figma-bot: Export queued — frames: 4 — formats: PNG 1x, PNG 2x, PDF (slides).
maria: @jon can you do quick brand sweep tomorrow AM (9:30am PT)? @legal-ops-bot add the final attribution line when you can.
jon: Yep — will review and flag any color/lockup issues at 9:30.
alejandra: Deadlines recap: initial thumbs in Figma by EOD today, review pass tomorrow AM, final exports Tue by 3pm PT (PNG 1x/2x + webinar PDF).
maria: Perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
notes: Design ask for launch visuals; includes Figma link, export naming, brand/legal checks. Thread intentionally brief and action-focused to mimic Slack style.
